name: spend-control
title: Spend control
description: Company spend dashboard in Tiles: an icon rail, an inverted upsell tile, virtual cards with limits, spending bars and a bubble chart of merchants.

props.name: data
props.description: The navigation items, spending bars, virtual cards, merchants and upsell tile to show.

props.name: labels
props.description: Visible text and screen reader text, with English defaults. Keys: title, cards, spending, merchants, limit, frozen, note, navLabel.

props.name: now
props.description: The current time. When given, its date is shown in the header.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO 4217 currency code for all amounts. Default "EUR".

props.name: onUpsell
props.description: Called with no arguments when the upsell tile's button is pressed.

a11y.text: A component, not a page: it has no main. A nav (default label "Sections") holds icon links with aria-label, title and aria-current; a header holds the h2 title. Each tile is a section named by its h3 (see data-tile).

Each card limit is a role="progressbar" named by the card, with aria-valuenow as the percent (capped at 100) and 0 to 100 as range; the spent and limit amounts are written next to it. The figure uses BigNumber and DeltaPill from chart-kit, and the charts are bar-chart and bubble-chart; see their notes.
Nav links and the upsell button are native, with a focus-visible outline.
The button scales on press, and under reduced motion (motion-reduce) it does so without a transition.
A frozen card says "Frozen" in place of its number. It is muted through its colours, not opacity, so its text keeps its contrast.
